annotation.title_clean: Implementation Plan of Shanghai Municipality for the Development of the Embodied Intelligence Industry
annotation.title_en: Implementation Plan of Shanghai Municipality for the Development of the Embodied Intelligence Industry
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Shanghai Municipal People's Government (published via Shanghai Municipal Bureau of Justice)
annotation.venue: Shanghai Municipal People's Government English portal (Bulletin)
annotation.summary_en: Shanghai's municipal implementation plan to develop the embodied intelligence industry through 2027–2028. It sets targets (100 leading enterprises, 50 billion yuan output), subsidies, vouchers, public platforms (computing, digital twin, pilot testing, investment, leasing), application demonstrations, talent and international cooperation. It is industrial policy, with little risk regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: By 2027: 20+ core technology breakthroughs, 4 incubators, 100 leading enterprises, 100 application scenarios, output above 50 billion yuan
R&D subsidies up to 30% of investment, capped at 50 million yuan per project
Five public platforms: computing power, digital twin training, pilot testing, investment, leasing
Demonstration applications in logistics, manufacturing, retail, healthcare/rehabilitation and household services
Effective 28 July 2025 to 27 July 2028; talent pilot zone and international humanoid-robot competitions
